title: Agenda tab
summary: The company account's Agenda, opened from Trabalho (business-tools): before activation an invitation to Ativar agenda; after it, a day view of the bookings for one person or Todos, with a now-line, Encaixe, Bloquear horário and Fechar hoje (docs/scheduling.md, owner flow).

businessId.description: Matrix ID of the company account.

serviceId.description: The Catálogo item of kind service.

serviceName.description: The service name, from the business's public services or the owner's catalogue.

agendaName.description: Name of the person or station.

start.description: Start, shown in the phone's time zone and locale.

customerUserId.description: The customer's Matrix ID. Absent for a name-only booking.

customerName.description: Name-only customer (encaixe). Absent for a signed-in customer.

activated.description: false when GET /v1/me/business/agenda answers not_found with reason agenda_off.

date.description: The day on screen, in the business time zone. Starts today.

agendaFilter.description: An agenda ID, or all for Todos.

bookings.description: GET /v1/me/business/agenda/bookings for the day (and agenda_id when filtered), by start.

of.description: One booking. Cancelled and no-show ones show dimmed.

pickAgenda.effect: Filters by one agenda or Todos.

addWalkIn.effect: Opens agenda-owner-booking in new mode, with the date and, when given, the time.

start.description: A free time that was tapped.

block.effect: Asks for a start and an end on the day, then POST /v1/me/business/agenda/blocks for the agenda on screen (or every agenda for Todos).

closeToday.effect: Asks bipe_agenda_close_today with bipe_agenda_close_today_body, then POST /v1/me/business/agenda/close-day for the agenda on screen or all. Then offers bipe_agenda_close_today_message, which the owner edits, and bipe_agenda_close_today_send sends it as a text message into the DM with each signed-in customer of that day's open bookings.

refresh.effect: Reloads the state and the day.

notes: The tab shows only when the current account is a company account (ADR 0103: the tab is Agenda). It sits after Grupos.
The close-day message goes through the encrypted chat from the owner's own phone; the server sends nothing (ADR 0102).
Moving by drag is not in this slice: Remarcar in agenda-owner-booking moves a booking.
Request mode badges (slice 2) count requested bookings on the tab.
